description: This file contains backend utility functions for object detection using RetinaNet with TensorFlow and Keras. It includes functions for bounding box transformation, anchor shifting, image resizing, and a wrapper for tf.map_fn, all tailored for the detection backend.

methods.name: bbox_transform_inv
methods.description: Applies regression deltas to bounding boxes, reversing normalization based on mean and std, to produce adjusted bounding boxes.

methods.name: shift
methods.description: Generates shifted anchor boxes over a feature map based on shape, stride, and base anchors.

methods.name: map_fn
methods.description: Wraps tensorflow's map_fn with support for different TensorFlow versions and optional output signature.

methods.name: resize_images
methods.description: Resizes images to a specified size using a chosen interpolation method, compatible with different TensorFlow versions.
